name: Hands & Sticks
author: Lyle Mills
description: Four clustered-impact voices cover handclaps, finger snaps, rimshots and struck wood without samples.

controls.label: Gesture
controls.description: Selects handclap, finger snap, rimshot or clave and woodblock.

controls.label: Tone
controls.description: Moves the body resonances and the noise colour from dark to hard.

controls.label: Tail
controls.description: Lengthens the cavity, shell or wooden body after the initial impact.

controls.label: Flam
controls.description: Spreads one impact into a wider cluster of hands or sticks.

outputs.main: The complete gesture with its resonant body.
